intro: Rhag Garmason tasks adventurers with checking on Ol' Ebenezer Rustlocke, a scout sent to inspect the massive stone crossing of the Thandol Span after contact with him is lost. Investigating beneath the arches of the crossing reveals the circumstances surrounding his disappearance and threats to the northern supply lines.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It seems as though poor Ol' Rustlocke ran into a Dark Iron ambush. You notice a parchment next to his clenched fist.
Report the grim news to Rhag Garmason and show him what you found.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Any sign of Ol' Rustlocke, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh my, the news is grave....
